title: Threat-Intel-2025-14
summary: Original summary of LSASS-access telemetry and credential-tool indicators used to support incident triage.
content:
## 4.1 [Investigate] Review process access to LSASS (citation: Threat-Intel-2025-14 p.4)
Review Sysmon Event ID 10 events targeting lsass.exe. Record the source process, access mask, user, and timestamp, then compare the activity with expected administrative tooling.

## 6.1 [Investigate] Compare credential-tool signatures (citation: Threat-Intel-2025-14 p.6)
Validate file hashes and loaded-module signatures against approved intelligence for credential-dumping tools. Treat unsigned or unexpected modules as leads for corroboration, not as standalone proof.
